exposure: Deoxynivalenol (DON) in diet (control: 0.15 mg DON/kg, contaminated: 4.42 mg DON/kg)
outcome: Histomorphological parameters of fetal organs (immune system, liver, intestinal tract)
Immunohistochemical parameters of fetal organs (CD3, CD79a, MAC, Ki-67 Antigen, p-p38 MAPK, caspase-3, caspase-9, TNFa)
cohort: Twelve pregnant sows (5 control, 7 experimental) and their porcine fetuses, exposed to different diets between days 35 and 70 of gestation.
finding: Exposure of pregnant sows to deoxynivalenol between gestation days 35 and 70 causes no pathomorphologically or immunohistochemically detectable alterations in the fetal organs examined.
gest_age: Fetuses examined at 70 days of gestation, with exposure from days 35 to 70 of gestation.
